---
name: Implementation or verification task
about: Track an implementation, test, observation, or evidence gap
title: "[Verify] "
labels: ["verification"]
assignees: []
---

## Claim to verify
State the exact claim or expected behavior.

## Current status
Choose: LIVE / PROTOTYPE / RESEARCH / CONCEPT / HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED / UNKNOWN.

## Required evidence
What test, execution record, observation, artifact, or external setting would establish the claim?

## Method
Describe a safe and reproducible verification procedure.

## Result
Leave blank until the check is actually performed. Record date, environment, and evidence links.

## Outcome
- [ ] Verified
- [ ] Failed
- [ ] Inconclusive
- [ ] Not run

Do not mark a task verified merely because a plan or attestation template exists.
